section.content: This utility model is related to a kind of biological gene configuration instrument, including configuring case, sterile board and detection platform are installed on the left of the configuration case, middle part in the detection platform is provided with protective cover, is provided with test tube rack and test kit, is provided with holding tank and antimicrobial flat-plate in the test kit in the sterile board, sucker is installed on the downside of the holding tank, flexible pipe is installed on the left of the test kit, limiting plate is installed on the test tube rack, the upper end of the sterile board is provided with handle.This utility model contributes to holding test tubes, storing reagent by setting test tube rack, test kit, holding tank and antimicrobial flat-plate and reduces the reagent in holding tank volatilizing, and by arranging, detection platform, protective cover, sucker and flexible pipe contribute to providing detection platform space and utensil protects and contribute to the position of fixed storage groove and medicament is input into.

本实用新型涉及种生物基因配置仪器，包括配置箱，所述配置箱的左侧安装有无菌箱和检测平台，所述检测平台上的中部安装有防护罩，所述无菌箱内安装有试管架和试剂盒，所述试剂盒内安装有存储槽和抗菌平板，所述存储槽的下侧安装有吸盘，所述试剂盒的左侧安装有软管，所述试管架上安装有限位板，所述无菌箱的上端安装有把手。本实用新型通过设置试管架、试剂盒、存储槽和抗菌平板有助于放置试管、存储试剂和减少存储槽内的试剂挥发，通过设置检测平台、防护罩、吸盘和软管有助于提供检测平台空间及器具防护又有助于固定存储槽的位置及药剂输入。

A kind of biological gene configures instrumentTechnical field

This utility model is related to biological gene device design technical field, more particularly to a kind of biological gene configuration instrument.

Background technology

Biological engineering is based on biological theory and technology, in conjunction with the modern times such as chemical industry, machinery, electronic computer work Journey technology, fully with the last word of molecular biology, ground manipulates hereditary material, directionally transforms biological or its function, short The new species with super remote edge character are createed in phase, then by suitable bioreactor to this kind of " engineering bacteria " or " engineering Cell strain " is cultivated on a large scale, emerging to produce a large amount of desirable metabolites or play their unique physiological functions one Technology.Genetic engineering is with molecular genetics as theoretical basiss, is given birth to molecule also known as gene splicing technology and DNA recombinant techniques Thing and microbiological modernism are means, by the gene of separate sources by the blueprint being pre-designed, build in vitro miscellaneous DNA molecular is planted, living cells are then introduced into, to change biological original inherited character, obtain new varieties, production new product.Gene Engineering technology provides strong means for the research of the 26S Proteasome Structure and Function of gene.However, existing biological gene configures instrument On lack the device for contributing to holding test tubes, storing reagent and reducing reagent volatilization in holding tank, the configuration of some biological genes Lacking on instrument contributes to providing detection platform space and utensil protection and contributes to position and the medicament input of fixed storage groove Device, it is impossible to meet the demand of practical situation.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to overcome the deficiencies in the prior art, there is provided a kind of biological gene configures instrument.

This utility model is to be achieved through the following technical solutions：

A kind of biological gene configures instrument, including configuring case, is provided with sterile board and detection is flat on the left of the configuration case Platform, the middle part in the detection platform are provided with protective cover, are provided with test tube rack and test kit, the reagent in the sterile board Holding tank and antimicrobial flat-plate are installed in box, sucker is installed on the downside of the holding tank, be provided with the left of the test kit Flexible pipe.

As optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, limiting plate is installed on the test tube rack, the sterile board upper End is provided with handle, and the right-hand member of the sterile board is provided with thread bush, is provided with standing screw in the thread bush.

Used as optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, the detection platform is located at the side of sterile board, and the detection is put down Platform is located at the downside of test kit.

Used as optimal technical scheme of the present utility model, the upper end of the configuration case is provided with adapter sleeve.

During onsite application, device is moved integrally correct position by operator first, then device is integrally fixed, its Secondary, waved by the reagent in test tube rack, test kit, holding tank and antimicrobial flat-plate holding test tubes, storing reagent and minimizing holding tank Send out, finally, detection platform space and utensil protection, then fixed storage is provided by detection platform, protective cover, sucker and flexible pipe The position of groove and medicament input, you can carry out biological gene instrument operation work.

Compared with prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are：This utility model is by arranging test tube rack, reagent Box, holding tank and antimicrobial flat-plate contribute to the reagent volatilization in holding test tubes, storing reagent and minimizing holding tank, are examined by arranging Surveying platform, protective cover, sucker and flexible pipe contributes to providing detection platform space and utensil protection and contributing to fixed storage groove Position and medicament input, and simple structure, easy to operate, economical and practical.
